lead_paragraphs: Frisal was a terrestrial planet located in the Frisal system, a part of the Atrisian Commonwealth in the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of loirbniggs, a species of eight-legged reptilian creatures.

The Galactic Empire maintained Frisal as a preserve world for affluent Imperial families. Members of the Imperial nobility also vacationed on the planet, and the aristocrats bred and trained loirbniggs for use as mounts.
